source: All-In Podcast — Anthropic $2T IPO, Zuck's AI manifesto, Nvidia $500B AI financing, Grok 4.6 / SpaceX AI strategy
summary: Grok 4.6 is Pareto-dominant on quality/cost and represents a genuine third frontier lab — most investors are not pricing Grok into SpaceX valuation
summary_extended: Baker argues that Grok 4.6, developed under the xAI/SpaceX umbrella, is Pareto-dominant on the quality-versus-cost frontier — outperforming Claude Fable 5 on quality at lower cost — and represents a genuine third frontier AI lab alongside OpenAI and Anthropic. He contends that virtually no SpaceX investors are pricing Grok's AI revenue potential into SpaceX's valuation, creating a significant mispricing opportunity. Baker draws an explicit analogy to Anthropic's revenue trajectory from $1B to $50B ARR, implying Grok could follow a similar monetization ramp, and notes that Grok 4.7 (a larger model with 1.5T+ parameters) is expected within weeks, which could further extend the quality lead. The investment implication is that investors evaluating SpaceX should materially increase the weight they assign to xAI/Grok as a revenue driver, and that the current market is undervaluing this optionality.
